item.title: BPH Energy Raises $1.2m to Support Gas and Neurotechnology Plans
item.description: BPH Energy (ASX: BPH) has received strong backing for its petroleum and neurotechnology investments, announcing it had received binding commitments from sophisticated investors to raise approximately $1.2m under a share placement offer.

item.title: Findi to Fund Expansion Plans with $72m Strategic Investment from Nova Global Opportunties
item.description: Findi (ASX: FND) subsidiary Transaction Solutions International (India) will receive a strategic investment of up to $72 million from Nova Global Opportunities Fund to support its rapidly-expanding operations.

item.title: iTech Minerals Delivers High-Grade Gold and Antimony Hits at Reynolds Range
item.description: iTech Minerals (ASX: ITM) has reported high-grade gold and antimony intersections from recent reverse circulation drilling at the Sabre and Falchion prospects within its Reynolds Range Project in the Northern Territory.

item.title: Venari Minerals Set to Release Maiden Red Mountain MRE after Further Lithium Mineralisation Success
item.description: Venari Minerals (ASX: VMS) has continued its progession toward a maiden mineral resource estimate with further positive drill results from its Red Mountain lithium project in Nevada, USA.

item.title: Brazilian Critical Minerals Generates High-Purity Oxides in Enrichment Testing of Samples from Ema REE Project
item.description: Brazilian Critical Minerals (ASX: BCM) has reported that initial bench-scale testing to enrich pregnant liquor solution from its Ema ionic adsorbed clay rare earths project has been completed at a US facility.

item.title: Separately Managed Advantages
item.description: With increased taxes on high superannuation balances, a lot of people are talking about alternative structures for keeping their investments, including a niche product known as a Separately Managed Account.

item.title: McLaren Minerals PFS Confirms Viability of $2.78b McLaren Titanium Project
item.description: McLaren Minerals (ASX: MML) has released a pre-feasibility study confirming the economic and financial viability of its namesake titanium project in Western Australia.

item.title: Taruga Minerals Hits High-Grade Gold in Rock Chips at East Normanby Project’s Weioko District
item.description: Taruga Minerals (ASX: TAR) will look to fast-track exploration of the Weioko gold district in Papua New Guinea after uncovering high-grade gold in rock chips at the East Normanby project.

item.title: NeuroScientific Biopharmaceuticals Reports Strong Results from Stem Cell Study on Fistulising Crohn's Disease
item.description: NeuroScientific Biopharmaceuticals (ASX: NSB) has confirmed that 75% of patients in the first cohort of a study into its StemSmart therapy to treat fistulising Crohn’s disease have demonstrated a positive clinical response following treatment.

item.title: Galilee Energy Adds to Leaseholding at Zydeco Gas Project in Louisiana
item.description: Galilee Energy (ASX: GLL) has secured additional lease agreements associated with the Zydeco project on the US Gulf Coast, expanding the gas and condensate field to now cover a leased area of more than 325 acres.
